## Line break elements

```bash
npm init
npm start
```

## Inline lines with breaks

```js
const a = 1;

const b = 2;
```

## Nested block lines

```yaml
key: value
  nested: true
```

## A bare break in pre

```
first
second
```

## A copy button

```sh
npm install
```

## Whitespace before code

```py
print("hi")
```

## Plain code keeps its own lines

```text
one

two
```
